examples.name: Human skin, inflamed eczema (Xenium 5K)
examples.description: Fresh-frozen adult skin from an inflamed eczema lesion on the Xenium Human 5K panel: 22,242 cells with transcripts and cell boundaries, from an atlas of skin fibroblasts.

source.citation: Steele L et al. (2025) A single-cell and spatial genomics atlas of human skin fibroblasts reveals shared disease-related fibroblast subtypes across tissues. Nature Immunology 26:1807-1820. doi:10.1038/s41590-025-02267-8

examples.name: Inflammatory skin, PhenoCycler 61-plex
examples.description: Akoya PhenoCycler-Fusion whole-slide scan of eight skin sections taken after Xenium, with 61 protein markers, read directly from an 81 GB QPTIFF.

source.citation: Steele L et al. (2026) Hidden immune memory niches in inflammatory skin diseases. bioRxiv. doi:10.64898/2026.03.20.713219

examples.name: Fetal lung T, NK and ILC cells (UMAP)
examples.description: Single-cell RNA-seq of 4,778 T, NK and innate lymphoid cells from human fetal lung, shown on their UMAP with 14 annotated cell types.

source.citation: He P et al. (2022) A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators of epithelial fates. Cell. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2022.11.005

examples.name: Adult human heart (Visium)
examples.description: Visium section of adult human heart, 4,992 spots with per-spot cell-type abundances (colour cells by Metadata), from a spatial atlas of cardiac niches.

source.citation: Kanemaru K et al. (2023) Spatially resolved multiomics of human cardiac niches. Nature. doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06311-1

examples.name: Mouse embryo E9.0 (Slide-seqV2)
examples.description: Slide-seqV2 puck of a whole E9.0 mouse embryo, 3,374 beads with cell-type annotations, from spatial maps of neural tube patterning.

source.citation: Sampath Kumar A et al. (2023) Spatial transcriptomic maps of whole mouse embryos reveal principles of neural tube patterning. Nature Genetics. doi:10.1038/s41588-023-01435-6

examples.name: Human tonsil, imaging mass cytometry
examples.description: Hyperion imaging mass cytometry of a human tonsil section with 27 metal-tagged antibodies, as OME-Zarr; opens on CD3 (T cells), CD19 (B cells), and CD68 (macrophages).

source.citation: Durand M et al. (2019) Human lymphoid organ cDC2 and macrophages play complementary roles in T follicular helper responses. J Exp Med 216(7):1561-1581. doi:10.1084/jem.20181994
